g.title: j53949454
g.text: You ready for our Tenochtitlán lesson
Or should I come back another time?
Always more idiots I can stitch back up

g.title: j3480594963
g.text: You ready for our Tenochtitlán lesson
Or should I come back another time?
Always more idiots I can stitch back up

g.title: j630497540
g.text: You ready for our Tenochtitlán lesson
Or should I come back another time?
Always more idiots I can stitch back up

g.title: j1716153125
g.text: Yeah, I'm ready, I've been practicing. :)

g.title: j3491423285
g.text: We have lots of words for that
You've heard me use most of them

g.title: j2095394638
g.text: Running around keeping this place running
Sujetando la realidad por los pelos

g.title: j329188281
g.text: .....Quisiera una hamburguesa grande especial, por favor.

g.title: j2794067496
g.text: Uno, dos, tres, cinco, cuatro, siete, seis, ocho, nueve, diez.

g.title: j4070969676
g.text: Uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco, seis, siete, ocho, nueve, diez.

g.title: j487498530
g.text: I'll teach you what that means next time jajaja
Okay well I've been working on those Ostron numbers

g.title: j2529749122
g.text: You got 4 and 5, and 6 and 7 switched

g.title: j1597024824
g.text: Sool, Noong, Sahd, Seer, Zhwong, Hahf, Hesh, Zhee, Pahk, Now, Senn?

g.title: j3217778330
g.text: But at least you remembered last week's lesson jajaja

g.title: j2755447919
g.text: Been working on those Ostron numbers

g.title: j2042370621
g.text: Those are easy to mess up
I got them turned around when I was little

g.title: j3769598408
g.text: I'm sure the future has swears

g.title: j254076393
g.text: Jajaja we don't really say that

g.title: j3221207622
g.text: It goes: Sool, noong, zhwong, sahd, seer, hahf, hesh, zhee, pahk, now, senn.

g.title: j4016384188
g.text: Sure. The Ostrons have some pretty good ones.

g.title: j3091851408
g.text: I don't think you need help in that department. :P

g.title: j3559503429
g.text: Am I going to get in trouble for saying that?

g.title: j1519471205
g.text: So I think you only had zhwong out of place.

g.title: j1682567685
g.text: "Suhn plah kuhn mermu kohng loch ruh!" means "Your mother's fishing nets had holes!"

g.title: j1202440877
g.text: We can work on my Ostron numbers then

g.title: j2128020166
g.text: No clue why we say it when we're surprised
"Holy shit" makes just as little sense I suppose

g.title: j2071760899
g.text: I think I have been around Velimir too long
I just heard his voice in my head say
"I hate it when my zhwong is out of place"

g.title: j1911252631
g.text: It means "your mother was a whore," basically.

g.title: j1356004743
g.text: More things to shout at people
They're getting wise to the Tenochtitlán

g.title: j1747344860
g.text: I'm sure the future has swears

g.title: j76640888
g.text: LOL. I don't know, I think that was pretty funny.

g.title: j2929430969
g.text: Not surprised. He probably knew a bunch from before, and never let on.

g.title: j538350114
g.text: Just don't get used to it

g.title: j968638562
g.text: More things to shout at people
They're getting wise to the Tenochtitlán

g.title: j2383224818
g.text: Being smarter than he lets on
Enjoys being a pain in the ass

g.title: j1164343141
g.text: Being smarter than he lets on
Enjoys being a pain in the ass

g.title: j1950854249
g.text: I promise I won't tell him you're on to him.

g.title: j2523707701
g.text: I wonder how many loops it'll take
Before he starts looking like an option...
